inputs_sent.prompt: A man sits at a table in a small meeting room in late-afternoon light, on a video call, seen by his laptop's webcam. He listens to a colleague giving an update: he looks at his screen just below the lens with a calm, attentive face and blinks naturally. He tilts his head a little as he follows, gives one small nod of agreement, and shifts a little in his chair. His lips stay closed: he does not speak at any time. Small natural movements only, like a real person listening on a video call. His hands stay out of the picture. Nobody enters the picture and nobody walks past behind him. The camera is a fixed laptop webcam: the framing does not change at all. At the end he is back in the same pose as at the start, looking at his screen. One continuous shot with no cuts, no zoom, no pan, no music, no subtitles and no text.

result.expanded_prompt:
How the reference pictures align with the target video — Picture 1 (from Shot 1) aligns with the 0.00-second mark of the target video; Picture 2 (from Shot 1) aligns with the 10.00-second mark of the target video.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Cinematic live-action, static shot from the perspective of a laptop webcam. A man (S1) in his late 40s with short brown hair and light stubble, wearing a dark blue collared shirt, sits in a small meeting room. The scene is bathed in the warm, golden glow of late-afternoon sunlight streaming through large windows in the background, creating soft shadows and highlighting his features. S1 is framed from the chest up, looking at the screen just below the camera lens with a calm, attentive expression as he listens to someone on a video call. He blinks naturally and his eyes move slightly as if following a presentation. Midway through, he tilts his head slightly to the left in a sign of engagement, then gives a single, slow nod of agreement. He shifts his weight slightly in his chair, causing a subtle movement in the fabric of his shirt. His hands remain out of the frame and the background of the office with plants and blinds remains still, with no people entering the frame. By the end of the shot, S1 returns to his original posture, looking directly toward the screen with a neutral, focused expression. The camera remains perfectly fixed throughout the duration without any movement.

overall_soundscape: The faint, quiet hum of an office air system is punctuated by the distant, muffled sounds of a keyboard and far footsteps. The soft rustle of fabric occurs as the man shifts in his chair, accompanied by the subtle, rhythmic sound of his calm breathing.
